request.description: Run 00-setup ONLY while the database is in its clean seed state (Diane in her original room).

exec: const by = n => list.find(r => r.firstName === n);
const aline = by("Aline"), eric = by("Eric"), diane = by("Diane");
pm.test("Aline, Eric and Diane found", function () { pm.expect(aline && eric && diane).to.be.ok; });
const inv = list.find(i => i.status === "INVITED" && i.vacancyTitle === "Mechanical Technician") || list.find(i => i.status === "INVITED");
const off = list.find(i => i.status === "OFFERED" && i.vacancyTitle === "Production Supervisor") || list.find(i => i.status === "OFFERED");
pm.test("seed INVITED and OFFERED interviews found", function () { pm.expect(inv && off).to.be.ok; });
